followUpTo: ISSUES #172 (#140 family): a LOCKED + ENCORED battler must not take the Encore retarget draw (audit aud159, STEP enc160)
title: Control: a Focus Punch user (pre-pass set-up, NOT a STATUS2_MULTIPLETURNS lock) Encored mid-turn by a faster foe takes the Encore arm and pays GetMoveTarget
scenario: Player SNORLAX (FOCUS PUNCH / TACKLE / AMNESIA / HEADBUTT) vs faster PLUSLE (ENCORE x4). Turn 1 TACKLE; turn 2 selects FOCUS PUNCH (BattleScript_FocusPunchSetUp pre-pass), PLUSLE Encores SNORLAX into TACKLE before it acts, and the action runs TACKLE with one GetMoveTarget draw.

sourceUnderTest.lockedArm: reference/pokeemerald/src/battle_util.c:107-110 HandleAction_UseMove: gBattleMons[attacker].status2 & (STATUS2_MULTIPLETURNS | STATUS2_RECHARGE) -> gCurrentMove = gChosenMove = gLockedMoves[attacker], NO GetMoveTarget call (the target banked at the locking turn rides). Checked BEFORE the Encore arms

fixShape: ISSUES #172 / STEP enc160: actionRetargetsAtExecution returns false when battlerStatusMoveLock(preClearRulesContext, battler) != 0 (source order: the :107-110 locked arm precedes the :111-128 Encore arms).
